user.title: Link the Smart Life app
user.description:
Enter the **user code** of the Smart Life or Tuya app: you find it in *Me → Settings → Account and Security → User Code*.

The cloud is only used now to download devices and keys: control will be fully local.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.description: Open the Smart Life app, tap the scan icon in the top right corner, scan the code and confirm the login in the app. Then press **Submit**.

devices.title: Choose devices
devices.description:
Found {count} locally controllable devices. IP address and protocol version are detected automatically; sub-devices (e.g. water timers) go through their hub, which is added automatically.

Not supported (no DP mapping): {skipped}

abort.no_devices: No locally controllable devices found in the account.
